Messages.Author: Francois Villon
Messages.Body:
1)If I have two master phase actions (via Parthenon, or Anson...), can I
play two master out-of-turn in a single round, or just 1 and in my turn I
can play a normal master?

2)Does environmental damage counts towards the damage useful to play Disarm,
or is my minion that has to do more damage than the other?

3)Is Legacy of Pander stackable?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <45jP6.3606$zb1.2...@news.infostrada.it>, Francois Villon
<federi...@libero.it> writes

>1)If I have two master phase actions (via Parthenon, or Anson...), can I
>play two master out-of-turn in a single round, or just 1 and in my turn I
>can play a normal master?

You can only ever play one.

"Out-of-turn: You may play an out-of-turn master card whenever
appropriate during another player's turn. Doing this counts against your
next master phase (see Master Phase, sec. 5). You may not play a second
out-of-turn card against the same master phase - you'll have to wait
until you square away the debt you owe on the first one. "

(If you want a way of remembering this, just imagine what would happen
if, say, Anson went to torpor, Gehenna was repealed or the Parthenon was
burned *before* you got to your next master phase. You wouldn't have
the master phase actions to pay it off.)

>2)Does environmental damage counts towards the damage useful to play Disarm,
>or is my minion that has to do more damage than the other?

"Only usable at the end of a round of combat in which this vampire
successfully inflicted more damage at close range than the opposing
vampire"

'this vampire' has to do the damage. Environmental damage, therefore,
doesn't count.

>3)Is Legacy of Pander stackable?

By current, Sabbat War card text, no.

Pander
> has one vote. Any Sabbat vampire may call a referendum to burn this card
as
> a +1 stealth political action."
>
> Does "has one vote" mean that each non-titled Pander gets ONLY 1 vote even
> if you play more than 1 Legacy of Pander?
>
>

yup.

The old text gave every Pander an *additional* vote. This meant that enough
Panders with enough LoP's could get vote lock, which is WAY too powerful
(the older vamps have a hard enough time as it is) and thematically
completely wrong.

Jeroen
